notes.title: New Legendary Bot Nova Descends from the Cosmos
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174402/9a670720a68526b243f955247d67236fc162f2ca.png[/img]
[h3][b]New Legendary Bot: Nova[/b][/h3]
A new Legendary bot has arrived! Nova is a Legendary Sniper who attacks enemy bots with bursts of plasma, and can harness the power of dying suns to regenerate itself. Acquire Nova by collecting Star Fragments from Danger Zones.

[h3][b]Major Gameplay Updates[/b][/h3]
Also included in this update are some major changes to Botworld Odyssey's gameplay and balance. We've listened to all the feedback we've received and have addressed a huge number of points raised with the following changes:

[b]Cosmetic Upgrade Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] The upgrades attached to certain player cosmetics and Bot Styles can now be swapped onto the cosmetic or Style you’d prefer to equip. To do this for player cosmetics, visit the Wardrobe in the boat. For Bot Styles, do this when viewing that bot’s Style page. Upgrades cannot be transferred to default player cosmetics or default Bot Styles, and both cosmetics must be unlocked in order to swap their upgrades.
[*] Your recruits will now earn coins and scrap for their battles by default, from the outset. You no longer need to have the Pirate Lord hat equipped.
[*] Pirate Lord hat rarity downgraded from Epic to Rare
[/list]
[b]New Content[/b]
[list]
[*] A new Bonus set of contract rewards have been added. Players who have completed the Level 7 Boat Contract rewards or higher will automatically have access to these rewards after the update. Earn tokens to unlock these new cosmetic items.
[*] New Legendary Boosters have been added
[*] Damage dealt and damage taken stats have been added to the end screen of battles in the Wilds
[/list]
[b]Recruits and Customisation[/b]
[list]
[*] Recruits’ names can now be changed by interacting with them in your Boat
[*] Additional Personal Style common player cosmetics have been added to the wardrobe
[/list]
[b]Balance and Economy Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased the amount of coins you receive by 20% across the board
[*] Increased the spawn rate of rare critters and objects tied to achievements
[*] Reduced the Danger Zone boss and fish achievement requirements from 100 to 30
[*] The chest earned when all Contract Rewards are completed at maximum Boat Level has been upgraded from Common to Rare
[*] Selling fish other than the Catch of the Day to the Fishmonger will give slight progress toward refreshing the next Catch of the Day option
[*] Boss bandit enemies will now drop coins as well as tokens
[*] Bot Styles for Legendary bots can be earned by defeating Mega Bots, once that Legendary bot has been upgraded to Level 30
[*] Polished Black and Pristine White styles can be earned by defeating Omega bots you have already built
[*] There are now more ways to earn shiny Bot Styles from a Raid. Each Raid wave you survive beyond Wave 10 will now earn you a shiny Bot Style, up to the maximum number of waves equivalent to your current Raid Level. As an example, if you have a Level 3 Raid, you will earn a shiny Bot Style for completing waves 11, 12, and 13, but not any wave afterwards.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes and UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the names of certain fish going off screen when caught
[*] Fixed various visual bugs with certain player cosmetics
[*] Fixed an issue where the Shop would not refresh when at maximum Boat Level
[*] Fixed some issues with Surge’s AI nodes not applying their effects correctly
[*] Fixed an audio bug that occurred if collecting two pieces of rare or epic loot at the same time
[*] Fixed the critter scrap burst cosmetic bonus not applying
[*] Extra battle dust clouds should no longer appear after ending a battle
[*] Adjusted the way the game saves data to prevent data corruption if the system shuts off while playing
[*] Visual hotkey glyphs have been added to the HUD for keyboard and mouse control. Press E to interact, Q to open the botpack menu, and the 1,2,3,4 keys to activate a battle ability
[*] Fixed an error when viewing upgrade ingredients on Legendary bots
[/list]

notes.title: New Epic Brawler Bot Surge Arrives! Plus: 20% Off for the Steam Winter Sale
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174402/857f2721db4fc6d64b8c8a3ba951d5f48290498b.png[/img]
[h3][b]New Bot: Surge[/b][/h3]
The first new bot to be added to Botworld Odyssey is here! Surge is a new Epic Brawler bot who has been sighted by brave Botmasters in the Molten Rock Danger Zone. It's a tough, slow bot that relies on its Botmaster using ability modules during battle to activate a charge and close the distance to deal huge melee damage.

[h3][b]20% Off Sale[/b][/h3]
Botworld Odyssey is 20% off for the Steam Winter Sale! If Botworld Odyssey has been sitting in your wishlist, now is the perfect time to discover the secrets of Botworld and become the world's greatest Botmaster!

[h3][b]Community Streams[/b][/h3]
Throughout the Steam Winter Sale, we're happy to be broadcasting VOD playthroughs and videos from some of Botworld Odyssey's community players and YouTubers. This sale we're featuring [url=https://www.youtube.com/@crispysense]Crispysense[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/@LadyShelab]LadyShelab[/url] - please check out their channels to see more of their content!

That's all from us! We hope you enjoy your holidays, and we look forward to bringing more new content to Botworld Odyssey in 2025!

notes.title: Endgame Progression Changes From Level 20-30
notes.content:
Botmasters, we've been listening to your feedback and are here with another update for Botworld Odyssey that reduces the amount of grinding you need to do to upgrade your bots between Level 20 to 30. These changes will make it easier to progress through the endgame, and will mean you won't be required to hunt down as many Alpha Bots as you did before.

[h3][b]Endgame Progression Changes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Alpha bots that used to drop one Essence upon being defeated will now drop three Essences
[*] When you open an Epic Danger Zone chests, you are always guaranteed to get at least one Essence
[*] When you open a blue chest or catch a runaway chestbot throughout the world, those chests will now have a chance to drop either rare scrap items, or an Essence
[*] The cost of Essences in the Shop has been further reduced to 1500 coins each
[*] The chance for Alpha Bots to spawn with a rare or an epic Bot Style has been slightly increased
[/list]
Thank you, and we hope you enjoy your time exploring Botworld's late-game areas!

notes.title: Matchmaking and Economy Balance Update
notes.content:
Hello again Botmasters! As we continue to work on Botworld Odyssey, we are listening to and taking into account all of your feedback and have the following improvements to share with you.

[h3][b]Economy Changes:[/b][/h3]
[b]We’ve greatly reduced the amount of scrap that is required to upgrade your bots once they hit Level 20.[/b] You will still need to seek and out defeat an Alpha Bot to acquire an Epic Essence for that bot each level, but the number of other materials required has been reduced. Additionally, [b]we have reduced the cost of Essences in the Shop from 5000 coins each to 3000 coins each[/b].

For players who are having trouble obtaining Rare upgrade materials like Chaser Cores and Brawler Batteries, we’d like to let you know that Alpha Bots will be guaranteed to drop a Rare material if you already have an Epic Essence for that bot, but have not yet used it in an upgrade.

[h3][b]Matchmaking Changes:[/b][/h3]
[b]We’ve done some work to narrow the allowable level range of opponents you may be placed against[/b] when fighting in the Solo League. In some situations, players were seeing opponents that were 2 to 3 levels higher than them; this should happen less from this point on. However, we’d like to offer some insight into how matchmaking actually works, as there has been some misconception that it is entirely based upon your Upgrade Level.

Firstly, what is your [b]Upgrade Level[/b]? This is the number that you see next to your character in menus, or on the minimap. It is calculated by getting [b][i]the average of your 6 highest level bots[/i][/b]. This number remains the same even if you equip a team of lower level bots; it will never go down. When fighting in the Solo League, it is intended for you to use your highest level bots.

However, your Upgrade Level isn’t actually the most important value when matchmaking in the Solo League. The number you want to pay attention to is your [b]Arena Rank[/b]. Your Arena Rank is the number shown at the bottom of the Solo League, and also seen increasing or decreasing after you win or lose each Arena battle. 

The matchmaking system attempts to find an opponent whose [b][i]Arena Rank is similar to yours[/i][/b]. In this part of the process, your Upgrade Level, and their Upgrade Level, is irrelevant. Once opponents at a similar Arena Rank have been found, only then will the matchmaking attempt to narrow its selection to an opponent with a closer Upgrade Level. 

As you start climbing the Arena Ranks, you may find that you keep facing opponents who are slightly higher level than you. This is intentional, and this means you have advanced into a part of the Solo League where you need to continue exploring the open world, completing quests, and upgrading your bots so that you can come back and keep attempting matches at a new level of power yourself. In order to earn every reward from the Solo League and reach an Arena Rank of 6000, it is expected that [b][i]you will eventually need a team of 6 bots in the range of Level 25 - Level 30[/i].[/b]

[h3][b]Other Fixes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the Raider Wargear outfit wasn't correctly awarded after a quest
[*] Fixed some item pickup text not fitting to the screen
[*] Alpha bots will now drop their loot if defeated by a Recruit, even without the Pirate Lord Hat equipped
[*] Fixed various situations in which Heroic Danger Zone loot would not refresh after completing Contracts
[*] Fixed an issue when the Shop would not refresh when at maximum Boat level
[*] Fixed an issue where the shop would not refresh when earning tokens in a multi-battle
[*] Prevented the Shop's offerings from refreshing when closing and opening the game - you must now correctly complete Contracts for it to refresh
[*] Fixed the timing of the player's jetpack effects when they are defeated
[*] Fixed an issue that caused your follower bot to disappear after an Arena match
[*] Fixed the glowing effects on Botpacks not displaying properly
[*] The maximum Boat level contracts rewards screen is now properly closeable with a controller
[*] Increased the spawn rate of certain collectable objects required for some achievements
[*] Fixed an issue where the 1, 2, 3 and 4 number keys would not activate abilities in Steam
[*] Lower level enemies will now take slightly longer to detect and pursue the player
[*] The Solo League loading screen now displays both yours and your opponent's Arena Rank
[/list]
Thank you, and we hope you continue to enjoy your time competing in the Arena and discovering the secrets of Botworld!

notes.title: Offline Play and Progress Reset Hotfix Now Live
notes.content:
Hello Botmasters! We're so thrilled that you're enjoying your time with Botworld Odyssey. To address some immediate feedback, we've released a small hotfix that includes the following changes:

[h3][b]Offline play:[/b] [/h3]
You can now play Botworld Odyssey completely offline, on both desktop and Steam Deck.

[h3][b]Progress Reset:[/b] [/h3]
You will now be able to reset your progress from within the game, if you so choose. To do this, open the Settings menu and choose the "Reset Progress" option. You will be asked to confirm your choice. Resetting progress will close the game, and the next time you open it you will begin again from the start. 

[i]NOTE: If this process doesn't work, please try again while disabling Steam Cloud support, and then re-enabling Steam Cloud after resetting your progress, and choosing to overwrite your Steam Cloud saves with your new local saves. To disable Steam Cloud, right click on Botworld Odyssey in your Steam Library, then choose Properties, then uncheck the Steam Cloud option.[/i]

Additionally, if you would like to change your character's appearance, please visit the Stylist in Scavenger's Landing. She will allow you to customise your character's outfit, skin colour, eyes, and even species. In this update we have reduced her cost from 200 coins to 20 coins.

[h3][b]Other fixes:[/b] [/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where a large blue texture would appear in battles
[*] Fixed an issue where fishing spots would remain in the world after a battle
[*] Fixed the ESC key not backing out of certain menus
[*] Fixed enemies immediately chasing you upon leaving a battle
[*] Fixed an issue that caused a feature popup to incorrectly appear after upgrading your boat
[*] Fixed an issue where Yanky's ultimate ability did not count to the Stun Enemy Bots in Battle contract
[/list]
Thank you, and enjoy your time in Botworld!
